question: Is the ban on torture and inhuman treatment subject to any exceptions, for example in wartime or a national emergency?
quote: The Convention prohibits in absolute terms torture and inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment, irrespective of the victim’s conduct. Unlike most of the substantive clauses of the Convention and of Protocols Nos. 1 and 4 (P1, P4), Article 3 (art. 3) makes no provision for exceptions and, under Article 15 para. 2 (art. 15-2), there can be no derogation therefrom even in the event of a public emergency threatening the life of the nation.
reason: States Article 3 makes no provision for exceptions and no derogation under Article 15(2) even in public emergency.
